name: write-ignite
description: Unofficial sales-page planning, drafting and review using Write & Ignite methods and no-ai-slop foundations.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a real offer into a clear, credible sales page.
interface.longDescription: An unofficial toolkit for developing an offer, planning a sales page, writing original brand copy and reviewing it against the core Write & Ignite resources. Peter Yang's no-ai-slop rules and evaluation apply throughout. Includes source coverage and practical checks for unsupported claims.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the sales-page skill to turn my offer and supporting evidence into a complete sales-page draft, then review it.
